location_exception_reason: Wooden houses are often marketed by origin location (Himalayan hill-station homes, Goan eco-resorts, Bengaluru farmhouses) because regional climate, timber sourcing, and architectural tradition genuinely influence buyer choice and construction suitability; location is a legitimate product attribute, not just a seller identifier.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in wooden house titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently, and removing these words leaves the product description complete and unambiguous.
